summary: Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Board of Directors approved gas reference prices for spot purchases for Plant Thermal Reduction with related parties for the 2026 winter period. The Audit Committee concluded the transactions are on an arm's-length basis under Section 72 of Argentina's Capital Markets Act. This is a routine related-party transaction disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, no premium, no change of control. What to watch: none; this is a regular operational matter under foreign issuer reporting obligations.
